title: 73% of Workers Give the IRS an Interest-Free $2,500 Loan
hook: Your employer's been taking too much from every paycheck — and you've been handing the IRS a $2,500 interest-free loan while paying 22% on your credit card.
angle: Not generic tax advice. Exposes the withholding trap most workers never question — getting a refund isn't winning, it's proof you overpaid all year and earned zero interest on your own money.
audience: Working adults 25-55 who get a tax refund every year and think it's a bonus
key_numbers: 0% — interest the IRS pays you on that money
$417,000 — what $2,753 invested yearly grows to in 40 years at 8%
